note: Machine-readable source for README.md. Release data checked via GitHub/Forgejo APIs on 2026-11-07. Game associations marked 'community-reported' come from the community update of the same date, not from upstream docs.

forks.name: Eglantine (Djihads80)
forks.notes: Derived from Eden, Yuzu and Sudachi; started by Camille LaVey. Daily builds, v0.1.0-rc1 and numbered builds. Build 135 added NUP metadata, 168 rumble, 189 DLSS/Streamline. Daily 7 Nov has OoT startup, rendering and recommended-settings work, but OoT still showed a black 3D world for some testers and the newest fixes are not in a stable release. Stability varies: 196 last stable for one tester, 202-212 regressions for another, 212 works after rebuild. rc1 is slower than 212 for several testers; Fire Emblem dropped from 50+ to 8-10 FPS on an RTX 30 card. Star Fox still fails to load (issue #533); a fix merged on 6 Nov was reverted.

forks.name: Eglantine (SmileyTatsu)
forks.notes: Fork of Djihads80. Pipeline-cache changes, guest RAM release, MKW frame-rate fix; not all merged upstream. README also points to upstream downloads.

forks.name: Orchid (MythosOfs)
forks.notes: Independent offshoot of Eglantine. Ampere shader lowerings, Switch 2 font handling, kernel thread-race and graphics fixes. OoT: v0.7.2 gameplay rendering, v0.7.3 exposure/haze/sky ambient fix, v0.7.4 vegetation restored. Exposure/fog workaround thins interior fog; EDEN_NX2_OOT_VISUAL_WORKAROUND=0 disables it. OoT performance unmeasured. Performance table measured on 5800X3D + RX 9070 XT with Mesa RADV git. PGO Windows/Linux builds.

forks.name: PokeDinner (Franseven)
forks.notes: 2.7.7 is Windows-only and explicitly experimental/broken. 1.x/2.0.0 tags include Linux AppImage and macOS arm64. Asks for 12 GB DRAM and a 32 GB pagefile/swap. Fire Emblem Fortune's Weave support is initial, not ready. PokeDinner 2.5 with the 30 FPS option is a recent DK result on an AMD 9600X and RX 6800 system; ZendNevs remains release-only.

forks.name: Eglantine (notsapinho)
forks.notes: Every push to main is published. x86_64 builds require AVX2 (Haswell+ / Ryzen). Pokopia listed as playable, with AMD-specific fixes, Linux support and a 120fps mod. One RTX 4060 Mobile user reached 80+ FPS with accurate GPU, docked mode and the 120fps mod. Stable 120 FPS is not possible on current Eglantine per the developer.

forks.name: Lichii (zortos293)
forks.notes: Latest release is tag build-94, called build-95 in-app; the workflow numbers runs, not tags, and both point to the same build. Releases now include Windows, Linux x86_64/aarch64 and macOS arm64 assets. Build 80 was an Actions artifact while Releases lagged at 75; build 88 added Frizti performance ports, pipeline preparation, FSR3 fixes and a bundled Dynamic FPS mod for OoT. Build 93 added AMD shader and Vulkan synchronization fixes, not yet verified in AMD gameplay. Build 94/95 fixes OoT foliage, white flashes, terrain overdraw, reticle and shaders, with limited gameplay testing. OoT field reports: 54-60 FPS on 9800X3D, 20-24 on i3-10100/RTX 3060, 12-22 on 5900X/RTX 3080 for build 75. 60 FPS claims are opening-area results on RTX 4080/5080/5090. Radeon black screens and driver crashes remain. Shares Eglantine data folders and shader cache; README still points downloads to the old zortos293/Eglantine releases page and asks for crypto donations.

forks.name: Lichii (Frizti)
forks.notes: Fork of zortos293/Lichii. Frizti v1 fixes OoT white flashes, adds a Max Resolution patch, and includes culling, vegetation, grass and fog fixes. Lichii build 88 credits Frizti for cached storage-buffer bindings, direct uniform uploads, batched readbacks and Dark's Dynamic FPS integration; some 60 FPS OoT footage comes from Frizti's own builds. Windows x64 only. 30 FPS without the Dynamic FPS mod; shader stutter remains; AMD black screens and driver crashes reported. Community workaround: EDEN_NX2_REJECT_HASH=e40561a7a0f7a0b3 in %APPDATA%\eden\nx2_switches.txt.

forks.name: Firefly (Kradnah)
forks.role: OoT-focused Lichii fork with performance profiles for laptops and mid-range PCs
best_for: Zelda OoT remake on laptops and mid-range PCs (self-reported)
a steady 30 FPS profile at normal game speed
forks.notes: Fork of zortos293/Lichii focused on the OoT remake, created 5 Nov 2026. Full source in repo, GPL-3.0; three prereleases (build-6, build-14, build-18), Windows only. AI-assisted commits disclosed (co-authored with Claude). Build 18 adds performance profiles picked from GPU memory and CPU threads on first start: 60 FPS, 30 FPS (docked, low-end mode, the game's step held to 30 FPS so it keeps its speed) and maximum performance (the same in handheld). It also ports Frizti v3's work and Eglantine PR 538, and fixes a low-end-mode black screen and a texture-cache deadlock on 4 GB GPUs. Self-reported on a Ryzen 5 4600H with an RTX 3050 Laptop 4 GB at the 30 FPS profile: steady 30 FPS indoors, 15-22 FPS in the busiest outdoor areas, with the GPU thermal throttling. Only NVIDIA tested, no independent reports yet. Not a first pick.

forks.name: Droplet
forks.notes: Modified eden-nx2 with Eglantine and PokeDinner work. Reservoir server branch adds a private NPLN replacement for MKW and Splatoon Raiders (friend codes, matchmaking, rooms, events) with Docker Compose. No keys or encrypted formats; decrypted folders, NRO/NSO/KIP only. v0.1.2 tag has no binary release; v0.1.1 binaries are marked old/outdated. P2P play exposes player IPs (per announcement); online CameraPlay unsupported; Splatoon sky bug; NUP archives slower.

forks.name: Eglantine nx2-merged (rdenno)
forks.notes: Fork of Djihads80 with its own nx2-merged builds. Hyrule Warriors fixes also exist upstream from build 202 onward.

forks.name: Banana Native (moceure)
forks.notes: Not an emulator: runs the game's ARM64 code natively and rebuilds NVN on Vulkan. Android 13+, Snapdragon/Adreno, 12 GB RAM. DK Bananza about 30 FPS, Pokopia about 60 FPS, MKW in progress with graphics problems. Requires own dump folder; no keys or firmware. Tested on one phone (Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5, 16 GB). The old eden-nx2-android is unmaintained and points here.

forks.name: Selevet Eglantine
forks.notes: Unofficial Eglantine build tuned for Zen 3 with PGO, ThinLTO and faster GPU mapping. DK reports: 30 FPS cap with 60 smooth motion on a 5700X3D and RTX 5070 Ti; 30 FPS cap worked on a 5090 and 7800X3D, with one freeze report.

forks.name: Eglantine ZendNevs
forks.notes: Merges Eglantine build-104, PokeDinner and Selevet Eglantine into one build (three codebases, not three executables). FSR 3/LSFG frame generation, DynamicFPS and a 30 FPS lock. v2.0.5 documents MKW at about 56 FPS average and 44-50 in the lowest 10% on a 5500X3D and RTX 4070 with 16 GB, DK Bananza at about 33 FPS average and 20.6 low with 99% game speed, and Pokopia startup at 60 FPS. DK still has hitches up to 0.6 s. Release-only repo: 2 commits, no license, README claims only MKW testing; source zip in releases. Recent independent reports favor SmileyTatsu for MKW and Selevet or PokeDinner for DK.

forks.name: EglantinePS5 (heydemoura)
forks.notes: Experimental Switch 2 emulator port for PS5. Check the repo's releases for current binaries.

forks.name: Eglantine 3060Ti 16GB
forks.notes: Patch set plus a binary release, not a full emulator source tree. Named for one specific GPU. No independent verification of benefits.

forks.name: Anka (EddizEge)
forks.notes: New project created 5 Nov 2026, built on Eden, Eglantine/PokeDinner, yuzu and Sudachi. Full source in repo and source zips in the release, GPL-3.0. One release, 7 stars, AI-assisted commits disclosed. DK measured on one PC (Ryzen 7 5700X, 64 GB, RTX 4060 Ti, 1440p): 42-53 FPS uncapped and 39-46 FPS with the dynamic frame rate patch, against 17.3 FPS for PokeDinner 2.0.0 in the heaviest view. The README calls it a rough indication, not a controlled A/B. Only DK measured; AMD and Intel untested. Not a first pick yet.

forks.name: nxnative (seedds)
forks.notes: Not an emulator: the game's own code runs on Apple silicon and NVN is rebuilt on Metal. Switch 2 support since 31 Oct; seven games listed: DK Bananza, Splatoon Raiders, Fire Emblem Fortune's Weave, Pokemon Pokopia, Hyrule Warriors, Mario Kart World and Mario Tennis Fever. Mac only; iPhone and iPad are untested for Switch 2. Builds a Mac app from one .nup file or a game folder; the NUP path does not need prod.keys. Requires macOS 26.6+, Xcode 27.2, Homebrew and Python 3.12+; first build is 30-60 minutes. No release assets at check. macOS counterpart to Banana Native.
